ImageDescription.value:
Distorted panoramic photo from a series of images of Bergenhus Fortress in central Bergen, Norway, taken in October 2021 and April 2022.
  • The images show the area and its surroundings, including the exterior façades of several buildings, notably the Bergenhus Fortress Museum (a military history museum with 1780 howitzers at the entrance) housed in the old Magazine Building (Magasinbygget), the Music Building (Musikkbygget, formerly the Proviantbygget) used by the Royal Norwegian Navy Band, Sverresborg Barracks, Sandbrogaten and Øvre Dreggsallmenningen streets, Haakon's Hall, parking areas, fences, gates, signs, cars, and more.
